raw_text: BREAKING: Reports of a military takeover in Niger. Presidential guard has surrounded the presidential palace in Niamey. President Bazoum reportedly detained by his own security detail. No official statement yet from the military. ECOWAS monitoring the situation. This follows weeks of tensions between Bazoum and the military leadership.
